Q3 Planning Sync — Summary

Product / Engineering / Ops · 2026-08-27 · Priya (PM), Marcus (Eng lead), Jenna (Ops), Dan (Design), Sara (VP Product)

Task

Summarize the meeting transcript as bullet points covering the key decisions/points and the next steps / action items.

Key decisions and points

  • Goal: lock Q3 scope by Friday so Sara can present at the exec review on Monday.
  • Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor (build, not buy).
    • Current engine fails on multi-currency batches: three incidents this quarter, reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ.
    • Rewrite scoped at ~6 engineer-weeks, including migrating the FX rounding module; needs Karim (platform) for 2 weeks on ledger integration.
    • Vendors rejected: Recur ($180K/yr) and LedgerFlow ($140K/yr, no support for jurisdiction-specific tax codes); both would still need ~3 engineer-weeks of integration.
  • Mobile receipt-capture ships v1 without bulk-select.
    • Design flows done; prototype tested with six users.
    • Testing surfaced two asks: bulk-select before upload (~1 sprint, out of scope for v1) and a much more prominent OCR confidence indicator.
    • Bulk-select goes on the roadmap as a fast-follow.
  • Vendor payout SLA (48h from invoice approval) is pending a trade-off analysis.
    • Current p95 is 71 hours. Bottlenecks: manual approval routing (ops) and the 12-hour ACH batching window (eng).
    • Proposed fix: cut ACH batch window to 4 hours and add a second west-coast approver; target 48h p95 by mid-Q3.
    • Eng cost: ~half a sprint plus SRE sign-off, due to more ACH files and monitoring load. Proceed if SRE says monitoring is manageable; otherwise set intermediate targets.
  • Audit-log retention update pushed to Q4 (confirmed with Legal).
  • Internal admin-tool refresh stays with the intern crew, no changes.
  • Engineering burnout: HR flagged a spike in bug-bash burnout; a lightweight rotating on-call proposal is requested.

Next steps / action items

  • Marcus Sync with Karim's manager and confirm his 2-week availability — this week
  • Marcus ACH batch-window trade-off analysis, including SRE sign-off on monitoring load — next week
  • Marcus Propose a rotating on-call structure — by Aug 31
  • Jenna Pair with Marcus on the ACH trade-off analysis — next week
  • Dan Update mobile receipt-capture specs (drop bulk-select, prominent OCR confidence indicator) — by Wednesday
  • Priya Add reconciliation as the Q3 anchor; note bulk-select as a fast-follow on the roadmap; circulate the scope draft for review — Thursday morning, ahead of Friday lock
  • Sara Present Q3 scope at the exec review — Monday
